purpose: Original decorative cartoon artwork for a Year 4 science learning environment
modifications: Converted to WebP for web delivery; artwork content unchanged.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single transparent PNG game-character sprite atlas for an educational game for children aged ten.
Primary request: exactly four charming colourful standalone characters, arranged on a square 1024 by 1024 canvas in a precise equal 2-by-2 grid. Each complete character is centered in its own 512 by 512 quadrant and stays wholly inside that quadrant. Leave generous genuinely transparent gutters around each character and between all quadrants, for independent CSS cropping. The surrounding area and gutters must contain actual transparency, no background.
Top-left quadrant: a cute large rooted seedling with exactly three chunky rich-green leaves, a short pale-green stem bearing an expressive happy face, growing from a small brown oval mound of soil with visible little roots anchored into it. A rooted plant, never legs or shoes.
Top-right quadrant: a rounded lavender and blue friendly miniature robot, expressive curious eyes on a dark face screen, a little antenna, two small friendly hands, an appealing curious expression.
Bottom-left quadrant: a cheerful golden-yellow sun character, round happy face and short chunky rays all around.
Bottom-right quadrant: a bright cyan water droplet character with a smiling face and a plump teardrop silhouette.
Style/medium: consistent polished 2D cartoon storybook game stickers, confident bold dark-green outlines, clean simple shapes and fills, subtle soft highlights and minimal shading, saturated but kind colours, expressive and charming. Equal visual scale across the four characters.
Constraints: one atlas only, all four characters fully visible, no overlaps, no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frames, no panel borders, no floating decorative extra objects, no backdrop, no checkerboard drawing, no photorealism. Real transparent alpha outside the characters.
